description: Host-level templates (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §7b, META_NODES): a template is a meta-flagged subtree; instances are generated subtrees with per-leaf divergence tracking. These cases pin the structural OUTCOMES of template operations (host operations; OxCalc sees ordinary structural edits). `op` is the gesture; expect describes the resulting tree / divergence record.

cases.name: instantiate materializes the template structure at a path
cases.note: Materializes Revenue/Cost/Profit from the template and registers the instance link.

cases.name: editing the template syncs to instances, skipping diverged leaves
cases.note: The structural diff (add Tax) applies to each instance via ordinary edits; the diverged leaf Year.Q1.Revenue is skipped.

cases.name: editing an instance leaf records per-leaf divergence
cases.note: Per-leaf override granularity: the node-path is recorded as diverged; future template edits to that leaf are skipped for this instance.

cases.name: detach drops the instance link
cases.note: The subtree becomes independent; later template edits no longer reach it.

cases.name: fit-check reports which template a subtree matches
cases.note: Given an arbitrary subtree, fit-check reports the templates it could be adopted as an instance of and the divergences that would be recorded.
